text.tspan: MASS MERGE EVENT
@unhappychoice merges 25 PRs in 7 days. Dependabot weeps with joy.
BREAKING NEWS
@unhappychoice upgrades chalk to v6.0.0, boldly drops Node <22 support forever
LONE SURVIVOR
@unhappychoice finds ONE real bug in a sea of 281 commits. Witnesses call it historic.
APPROVE MACHINE
@unhappychoice rubber-stamps 52 PRs across 14 repos. Fingers reportedly still intact.
RUST DRAMA
@unhappychoice battles gix 0.86 remote name disambiguation. Emerges victorious.
MONDAY MASSACRE
@unhappychoice drops 73 commits before the week even gets going. Authorities alarmed.
CROSS-ORG CHAOS
@unhappychoice invades circleci-tools, irasutoya-tools AND bitflyer-tools in one week
CSS JUSTICE
@unhappychoice finally styles h6 in mdts v0.20.6. Dead CSS variables have been eliminated.
